_doc: Per-edition takedown record for compact-alignments (see pipeline/lexeme_aligner/takedown.py). Key = edition tag. withdraw: 'edition' (leaves all three compact repos and the manifest; the pool no longer offers it), 'rend' (no rend channel), 'rend_above_eflomal' (rend only on eflomal entries, 0 elsewhere; opt-in, never the default). Keep reason and date so the history is auditable. Pooled datasets use config/senses_exclude.json.
